mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting a contractor about caregiver quarters?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before meeting with a remodeling contractor, compile a list of your caregiver's practical needs and measure your available living areas. Determine whether your caregiver requires a completely private entrance, a private bathroom, or dedicated cooking facilities like a kitchenette. Check your property survey to understand yard boundaries if you are considering an outward addition. You should also inspect your existing electrical panel to see if it has open breaker space for extra circuits and decide which current rooms you are open to reconfiguring. Sharing these details early streamlines the initial estimate and helps the contractor develop accurate floor plans.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clarify privacy needs like separate entries or kitchenettes, locate your property survey for yard additions, check your electrical panel capacity, and list essential mobility features.
